chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab from Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about a man who died and left behind his brother from the same father and mother and his grandfather. He عليه السلام said: “The property is divided between them, whether they are two brothers or a hundred. The grandfather is with them as one of them; the grandfather has the like of the share of one of the brothers.”

key_terms.أَخَاهُ لِأَبِيهِ وَ أُمِّهِ: his full brother, sharing both father and mother
key_terms.نَصِيبِ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الْإِخْوَةِ: the share equal to one of the brothers

ai.seo_question: How is the inheritance divided between full brothers and a grandfather in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance when a deceased person leaves behind full brothers and a grandfather. It states that the grandfather is counted like one of the brothers and receives a share equal to that of a single brother in the division of the estate.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5640 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Riʾab from Zurarah, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a man who died and left behind his full brother (from the same father and mother) and his grandfather.
Imam (as) said: "The inheritance is divided among them as if they were two brothers or even a hundred. The grandfather is considered as one of them; he receives a share equal to that of one of the brothers."
